## 4. lore — How an overflowing measure became very

**ANNA:** A note. How an overflowing measure became very

**ANNA:** ரொம்ப
> Textbooks will tell you this is just the word for very.

**ANNA:** Older Tamil remembers where it actually comes from.

**ANNA:** It started as an old word for filling a measure right to the brim.

**ANNA:** Like water poured into a vessel until it spills over.

**ANNA:** ரொம்ப
> Centuries of kitchen talk softened that full measure into daily speech.

**ANNA:** ரொம்ப சந்தோஷம்
> So when an elder says their joy is full, it is brimmed over.

**ANNA:** ரொம்ப நாளாச்சு
> Or when time stretches out, too many days have spilled past.
